The Emerson College Polling survey, conducted July 19-20 among 1,100 likely 2026 voters, with a plus or minus 2.9 percent margin of error, found Democrats leading Republicans by 53 percent to 42 percent on the generic congressional ballot.

In the same poll, President Donald Trump’s approval rating stood at 39 percent, while his disapproval rating was 57 percent, giving a net approval rating (those who approve minus those who disapprove) of -18.
